C0669.title: Two Men Sentenced for Extorting Drink Vendors by Adding Insects to Beverages
C0669.summary: Two men repeatedly placed flying insects into purchased drinks and then demanded money from vendors by claiming food safety violations. The court convicted them of extortion, sentencing both to imprisonment and fines.
